shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile with predatory head
repeated animal figures (in B) vs single beast (in A)
justification: Both depict predatory quadrupeds seen in profile with pronounced heads and jaws, which is a real if broad correspondence in subject. But A is a single fully three-dimensional beast standing alone, whereas B is a multi-register composition of relief figures — rows of arch-like motifs, birds, a snake-like/plant form and small crouching creatures — arranged in stacked bands, so the composition, relationships and rendering conventions barely overlap.
